name: rtx3060
description: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 12GB (GA106, Ampere, sm_86) at its 1320 MHz base clock: one Vortex core per SM.

sources.NUM_CORES, NUM_WARPS, NUM_THREADS, ISSUE: 28 SMs (3584 CUDA cores), 48 resident warps per SM (compute capability 8.6), 4 processing blocks each with its own scheduler and L0 instruction cache (NVIDIA Ampere GA102 whitepaper, SM)
sources.NUM_ALU_LANES, NUM_FPU_LANES, NUM_LSU_LA: GA10x SM processing block: 16 FP32 cores plus 16 cores that run FP32 or INT32, 4 LD/ST units, 1 SFU, 1 tensor core (GA102 whitepaper): 32 FP32, 16 INT32 and 4 LD/ST lanes per block. The shared FP32/INT32 half is modelled as FPU lanes, so an INT and an FP32 instruction can overlap where the part would share those 16 cores. FP64 (2 per SM on the part) is not modelled separately: with XLEN=64 all 128 FPU lanes execute FP64
sources.LMEM_NUM_BANKS: 128 B per clock per SM: 32 banks of 4 B on the part (CUDA C++ Programming Guide, shared memory). Vortex banks are XLEN wide (8 B), so 16 banks carry the same bytes per clock; lanes reading one 8 B word share its bank access, so a stride-1 FP32 warp read is conflict-free as on the part
sources.L2_SIZE, L2_NUM_WAYS, L2_NUM_BANKS: 3 MB L2 (GA106): 24 ways over power-of-two sets; one bank per memory channel
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_TYPE, PLATFORM_MEMORY_NU: 192-bit GDDR6 at 15 Gbps: 6 devices x 2 x16 channels = 12 channels, modelled as 16 at 11250 MT/s for a power-of-two interleave: 16 x 2 B x 11.25 GT/s = 360 GB/s, the card's bandwidth; latency not calibrated
sources.PLATFORM_CLOCK_RATE: 1320 MHz base clock (1777 MHz boost), base as in rtx5080
sources.EXT_TCU_ENABLE, TCU_*: Third-generation tensor cores, one per processing block: FP16/BF16, TF32, INT8, INT4, 2:4 sparsity
sources.TCU_PE_RATIO: 512 dense FP16 FMA per clock per SM with FP16 accumulation: 51.2 TFLOPS at the 1777 MHz boost clock over 28 SMs (NVIDIA Ampere GA102 whitepaper, Appendix A, RTX 3060 column). 4 TCU blocks at NUM_THREADS=32 give 1024 FP16 FMA per clock: ratio 2. The part runs FP16 at half that rate when it accumulates in FP32 (25.6 TFLOPS), which the TCU, FP32 accumulator only, does not separate
sources.EXT_RTU_ENABLE: Off although the part has one RT core per SM: the RTU needs full-warp ALU lanes (NUM_ALU_LANES == NUM_THREADS), and the part's 16 INT32 lanes per block take precedence
sources.NUM_MUFU_LANES: 16 special-function results per clock per SM (compute capability 8.6)
sources.VM_ENABLE, EXT_A_ENABLE, EXT_ZACAS_ENABL: As in the other NVIDIA profiles: demand-paged MMU, atomics with CAS, FP16, 16 named barriers, and the graphics pipeline of a GeForce part
sources.FDIV_PE_RATIO, FSQRT_PE_RATIO, FCVT_PE_R: 16 results per clock per SM, 4 per processing block: FP32 reciprocal and reciprocal square root, on which division and square root are built, and the 32-bit type conversions (CUDA C++ Programming Guide, arithmetic instruction throughput); 32 FPU lanes / 8, compute capability 8.6
sources.LMEM_SIZE, LMEM_LOG_SIZE: 100 KB maximum shared memory per SM (CUDA Programming Guide, compute capability 8.6) in a 128 KB window
